text: DSH Whale Pet 是一个面向 DSH 网页客户端的界面小组件，会在空白新会话的输入框上方显示像素风鲸鱼。它通过 conversation.input.dock 插槽注册客户端组件，并在会话离开空白状态后隐藏。鲸鱼会眨眼、摆尾、喷水和潜水；点击可触发跳跃与喷水，也会遵循减少动态效果的系统偏好。适合希望为新会话添加轻量动画陪伴的 DSH 网页用户。代码中未发现外部服务或 API 密钥配置。

DSH Whale Pet adds a pixel whale above the composer in blank DSH web sessions through the conversation.input.dock slot. It blinks, flaps, spouts, and dives; clicking makes it hop and spout. It hides after a session becomes active and respects reduced-motion settings.
想给 DSH 的空白新会话加一只会动的像素鲸鱼。
Can I add a small animated companion above the DSH composer before starting a chat?
让网页端的新对话界面显示一个可点击互动的小宠物。
DSH Whale Pet 的功能「新会话像素鲸鱼」：在空白新会话的输入框上方显示动画鲸鱼，并在用户开始运行或提交提示后隐藏。鲸鱼会自动摆尾、眨眼、间歇喷水和潜水；点击鲸鱼会让它跳跃并喷水。

dsh-whale-pet README · DSH Whale Pet：A lightweight, pixel-art companion plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (`dsh-whale-pet`) that adds an animated whale pet above the input composer during new sessions.

Drawn in the style of the DeepSeek whale logo, this little companion keeps you company when opening a fresh conversation and automatically tucks away once you start chatting.

dsh-whale-pet README · Features：- **Animated Pixel Art**: Handcrafted inline SVG sprite that bobs, blinks, flaps its tail, and spouts water every few seconds.
- **Interactive**: Click or tap the whale anytime to make it perform an instant hop and water spout.
- **Unobtrusive**: Appears exclusively on empty new sessions and gracefully disappears the moment you send a message or start a run.
- **Lightweight & Crisp**: Rendered with crisp pixel rendering (`shape-rendering: crispEdges`) and stepped CSS keyframes without heavy external asset dependencies.
- **Accessible**: Automatically halts animations when `prefers-reduced-motion` is enabled in system settings.
- **Localization**: Supports English (`en`) and Chinese (`zh`) accessibility descriptions.

dsh-whale-pet README · How It Works：- Hooks into the `conversation.input.dock` slot directly above the composer card.
- Evaluates session activity (`blank && !running && !promptAttempted`) so it stays completely out of the way during active conversations.
- Renders as a self-contained inline SVG using CSS step-timing functions to emulate classic retro sprite sheets.

dsh-whale-pet README · Installation：Install the plugin into your DSH web profile:

```sh
dsh-whale-pet README · From a local folder：dsh plugin --profile web add file:path/to/dsh-whale-pet

dsh-whale-pet README · Or directly from a Git repository：dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Gorkaseto/dsh-whale-pet.git
```
